sections.label: The Models
paragraphs: Kimi K3 on max effort against GPT-6 Astra on low effort. Game 8 of ten, drafted fresh.

The clearest case in the series of a game lost to execution rather than judgement. Kimi identified the right target on turn 3 and tried to kill it three times across two turns; all three attempts were cancelled on their costs, and the creature lived.

sections.label: Draft
paragraphs: Picks and reasoning are [[view:draft|here]], the final lists [[view:decks|here]].
Kimi drafted Dimir removal — [[card:Deadly Precision]], [[card:Fatal Fissure]], [[card:Swampsnare Trap]], [[card:Epic Downfall]] — behind [[card:Pirate Peddlers]] and [[card:Foggy Swamp Hunters]].

Astra drafted Golgari earthbend: [[card:Dai Li Indoctrination]] and [[card:Rockalanche]] to animate lands, [[card:Long Feng, Grand Secretariat]] as the value engine, and [[card:Buzzard-Wasp Colony]] and [[card:Boiling Rock Rioter]] as the threats that finish.

rounds.label: Turn 1
paragraphs: [[player:PilotB|Astra]] takes the play, mulligans a five-land seven, and keeps a six with three lands and its earthbend curve.
[[player:PilotA|Kimi K3]] leads on a tapped [[card:Boiling Rock Prison]].

rounds.label: Turn 2
paragraphs: [[player:PilotB|Astra]] casts [[card:Dai Li Indoctrination]] and animates a Swamp into a 2/2.
[[player:PilotA|Kimi K3]] casts [[card:Forecasting Fortune Teller]] as a 1/3 wall.

rounds.label: Turn 3
paragraphs: [[player:PilotB|Astra]] casts [[card:Long Feng, Grand Secretariat]], its engine.

[[player:PilotA|Kimi K3]] reads the board correctly — Astra is tapped out, Long Feng is summoning sick — and casts [[card:Deadly Precision]] on it, sacrificing a Clue for the additional cost. The cast is cancelled on a payment problem and Long Feng survives.

rounds.label: Turn 4
paragraphs: [[player:PilotA|Kimi K3]] tries again, twice. [[card:Fatal Fissure]] resolves on Long Feng — meaning Kimi earthbends 4 if it dies this turn — and then [[card:Deadly Precision]] goes on the stack to finish the job and is cancelled a second time, this time because the payment tried to use mana Kimi did not have. The Fissure's bonus expires unused.
[[player:PilotB|Astra]] plays a fourth land and carries on with the engine intact.

rounds.label: Turns 5 to 8
paragraphs: Astra's earthbend deck does what it does when unopposed: animated lands attack, [[card:Long Feng, Grand Secretariat]] grows on every death, and the board widens. Kimi holds at 20 life until turn 9 and then falls to 3 by turn 15.

[[player:PilotA|Kimi K3]] stabilises behind a 3/3 deathtouch [[card:Pirate Peddlers]] and a crewable [[card:The Fire Nation Drill]], which is enough that Astra declines to attack into it for two full turns.

rounds.label: Turn 9
paragraphs: [[player:PilotB|Astra]] tries to cast [[card:Buzzard-Wasp Colony]] three times in one turn and has two of the attempts cancelled on land IDs before giving up and passing — the same class of failure that cost Kimi the game five turns earlier, and this time it costs Astra only tempo.
[[player:PilotA|Kimi K3]], at 3 life, attacks with a 1/2 flier for 1 because it is the only unopposed damage available.

rounds.label: Turn 10
paragraphs: [[player:PilotA|Kimi K3]] plays its best turn of the game: [[card:Swampsnare Trap]] kills the 4/4 flying Colony, a Clue draw turns on its own creatures, and an attack with a 3/2 flier, a 4/4 deathtoucher and a lifelinking [[card:Foggy Swamp Hunters]] takes Astra from 15 to 5 and Kimi back up to 6.
[[player:PilotB|Astra]] rebuilds the Colony, sacrificing an animated Swamp to grow it and draw.

rounds.label: Turn 11
paragraphs: [[player:PilotB|Astra]] casts [[card:Invasion Tactics]], which makes [[card:Boiling Rock Rioter]] a 5/5, and attacks for exactly 6 into a board where every one of Kimi's creatures is tapped from its own alpha strike. Kimi dies on turn 21 at 6 life, one turn after taking Astra to 5.

Two turns decided this. On turns 3 and 4 Kimi had the read, the removal and the window, and three casts in a row failed on their costs — a 2/3 that should have died on turn 5 instead grew for sixteen turns. And on turn 10 Kimi's alpha strike left nothing untapped, which is what made exactly 6 damage lethal.
